name: ページ見本を備えた資料タイル
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create one redesigned Japanese Lighthouse catalog component LH15-0005, document-preview grid tile. White canvas, no device or page.
Image1 ORIGINAL controls icons, detail geometry, proportions, spacing and optical weight. Use ONLY its bottom-left Resume tile at source x47 y1808 w497 h426. The original blue document type glyph with white horizontal lines and gray horizontal overflow dots take priority over rough mock vector. Image2 is the ORIGINAL-derived document thumbnail crop: preserve it faithfully as existing media with the exact crop, green rule, Sam Lee heading, tiny existing printed content and page/shadow. Do not rewrite, invent, enlarge or translate its artwork text. Image3 OUR MOCK supplies Japanese product copy and secondary arrangement; correct its generic green blank-file icon using original. Image4 supplies white rounded card/fine border craft only; no borrowed colored circles or content.
Exact Japanese interface title under preview: "活動の概要". No other product copy. Meiryo Regular14/24px, tracking0, same role and wrapping as mock. Preserve original artwork's embedded English as image content only.
Compact logical tile width174px: document thumbnail174x102 at top with gently rounded frame corners; beneath it one40px row: original blue doc glyph left, 活動の概要, three small horizontal slate dots right. Do not clip text, omit dots or add controls.
White #FFFFFF page and card, thin neutral border, soft restrained downward shadow, subtle24px-style card corners scaled appropriately. Ink#1D1D1D, utility dots#526173. Preserve green inside document artwork and blue file-type artwork as semantically faithful media; no random accent, mint panel or tinted chip. No CTA exists, so no invented forest-green button or gradient.
Originals are primary for glyphs and fine details; our mock is secondary. Keep original thumbnail exactly rather than generating a new résumé. No surrounding file tiles, source app nav, watermark, labels, IDs, captions or invented metadata. Static design candidate.
reviewNotes: 原図・原図由来の文書見本・自作を全て開いて比較。原図を優先し青い文書形式と三点操作を復元、活動の概要の日本語を保持。生成を目視し、原文書の細かい英字やメールアドレスが再生成され厳密な原メディア保持は未達。原メディアをそのまま利用できる修正が必要。緑の原文書内容と青い形式表示以外は白・中立、余計な操作なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
